component-o.description-s: 10 A 100 V Schottky barrier rectifier, 950 mV VF max @ 10 A, TO-263

forward_source-o.datasheet-s: MBRB10100CT.pdf (Blue Rocket, Rev.F May-2016, Chinese/English bilingual)
forward_source-o.table-s: Absolute Maximum Ratings (Ta = 25 C): Average forward rectified Current IF 2X5 A, i.e. 5 A per leg (10 A per device, Fig. IF-TC p3), matching passive-o current-max-i 5000

dynamic_resistance_source-o.fig-s: IF - VF (Electrical Characteristic Curve), TA = 25 C curve (rightmost, labelled; checked on a render); vector curve read with procurement pdf-graph --points, log current axis. Its 5 A point (0.784 V) sits under VFM 0.85 V max at IF = 5.0 A, Tj = 25 C (p2), so the curve is per leg
dynamic_resistance_source-o.derived-s: chord over the upper half of the 5 A per-leg rating: vertices 0.68634 V at 2.5083 A and 0.78387 V at 4.9845 A: (0.78387 - 0.68634) V / (4.9845 - 2.5083) A = 0.09753 / 2.4762 = 39 mOhm. Typical curve, 25 C
